I confirmed the fix with a reproduction app (app-level `HTTPBearer` plus a router-level `APIKeyHeader`): both schemes now appear in `components.securitySchemes` and in the operations' `security` lists. Two related security test files pass (6 tests). I did not run the wider suite, and I did not add a regression test.
